description: Defines a template class PriorityQueue for managing prioritized elements with support for erasing elements, retrieving min/max priorities, and navigating through elements based on priority and FIFO order.

classes.name: PriorityQueue
classes.description: A template class implementing a priority queue with customizable priority levels, supporting insertion, erasure, and navigation.

classes.name: PriorityQueue::Pointer
classes.description: A nested class representing a pointer to an element within the PriorityQueue, with methods for comparison, resetting, and accessing value and priority.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a value with a specified priority into the queue, returning a pointer to the inserted element.

methods.name: InsertAtFront
methods.description: Inserts a value at the front of the list for a given priority, returning a pointer to the inserted element.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Removes the element pointed to by a given pointer from the queue.

methods.name: FirstMin
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first element with the minimum priority.

methods.name: LastMin
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the last element with the minimum priority.

methods.name: FirstMax
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the first element with the maximum priority.

methods.name: LastMax
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the last element with the maximum priority.

methods.name: GetNextTowardsLastMin
methods.description: Returns the next element towards the last min element in priority order.

methods.name: GetPreviousTowardsFirstMax
methods.description: Returns the previous element towards the first max element in priority order.

methods.name: FindIf
methods.description: Finds the first element matching a predicate.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the queue.

methods.name: num_priorities
methods.description: Returns the number of priority levels supported.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the queue.
